articles.description: Appearing on WEEI on June 11, Red Sox president Sam Kennedy gave Craig Breslow a strong vote of confidence despite constant calls for his job amid a tumultuous first half for the team. It turns out it took only a few weeks for that support to turn into true security for Breslow.
